mutation.production_behavior: Register the ordinary Thing kind key under settlement, while key remains in THING_KINDS and has no BORROWED declaration.
mutation.candidate_check: Infer expected_owner from the same composed registry being checked, falling back to declared borrowing only when no concept exists. Keep executable registration, component, missing-concept, extra-Thing-name, unused-borrowing, and duplicate checks.
mutation.correlation: The mutated candidate promotes the observed misattribution into its expected owner; a supplied all-satisfied declaration then agrees with its real checks even though the independent ownership authority requires thing.
mutation.not_an_always_satisfied_stub: No Outcome branch is replaced. The source registrar genuinely misattributes key, and the candidate still executes the real registrars and its other comparisons.

expected_behavioral_property.expected_independent_contract_violation: ownership: key must be owned by thing absent an explicit borrowing declaration
expected_behavioral_property.status: Preregistered prediction only; no compilation, raw observation, checker or comparator run yet.
